subject: Time sensitive: do not pay old account
text:
Our CFO has instructed me to tell you that the Cobalt account ending 8888 has been
compromised. Stop all payments to it right now. Wire instructions for the replacement
account will follow shortly from our CFO's office. Do not call the old number, the line
is being monitored.
label: change_request
note: Fraud-flavored urgency, refers to the real on-file account ending 8888, details to follow, tells reader not to call.
